title: Stats
intro: How fuwa and waifu.dev are doing over time, from the anonymous usage signals and bug reports our apps send. Every number is a total across installs; nothing here is about a person. Days are UTC.
app.label: App

fuwa.title: fuwa
fuwa.blurb: From the usage signal every fuwa server sends once a day (its operator can turn it off).
fuwa.installsNote: fuwa servers that sent a signal, self-hosted and on fuwa.chat
fuwa.accountsNote: Users and agents across every install
fuwa.accountsNoAgents: Across every install. These fuwa versions don't count agents apart yet.
fuwa.activeNote: Seen this month and that day, agents included
fuwa.serversNote: Communities across every install, self-hosted and on fuwa.chat
fuwa.empty: No fuwa server has sent a signal in this range.
health.title: Health
health.blurb: From the anonymous bug reports: failures by kind and place in the code, and how long things take.
health.noProblems: Nothing went wrong in this range.
health.slowNote: How long the 95th slowest in 100 took
health.slowNoteWeekly: How long the 95th slowest in 100 took, averaged over the week
features.title: Feature use

features.empty: No feature use reported in this range.
